[sheet README]
A1=Quasi-Static Magnetic Circuit - Synthetic Engineering Evidence Register
A3=Hackathon task: infer a coherent SysML v2 representation from heterogeneous evidence for a quasi-static magnetic circuit with an iron core, discrete air gap, leakage branch, exciting coil, measuring coil, flux sensor, and electric/magnetic grounds. The evidence intentionally contains superseded permeability, leakage, measuring-coil and as-built geometry values.
A8=Effective benchmark parameter | B8=Value
A9=Core side a | B9=25 mm
A10=Reference dimension l | B10=150 mm
A11=Nominal gap delta | B11=1.50 mm
A12=Relative permeability | B12=1200
A13=Leakage coefficient sigma | B13=0.08
A14=Exciting coil turns | B14=600
A15=Measuring coil turns | B15=50
A16=Frequency | B16=50 Hz
A17=Current ramp | B17=0 -> 2 A RMS, 0.10-0.50 s
